messages.content:
Articles:

[support] Support hours and response targets
Community support (Starter) is best-effort via the forum. Email support (Pro) is staffed Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 18:00 UTC, with a one-business-day first-response target. Enterprise support is 24/7 for severity-1 incidents with a four-hour response target, and business hours for everything else. Severity-1 means the product is unavailable or data is at risk for all users of a workspace. Status and incident history are published on the status page.

[security-incident] Reporting a security issue
If you believe you have found a vulnerability or that your account has been compromised, email security@ (or use the in-app 'Report a security issue' link) rather than opening a normal ticket. Include what you observed, the time, and any request IDs. We acknowledge reports within 24 hours and do not take action against good-faith researchers. For a suspected account compromise, also rotate your API keys immediately from Settings > API keys and enable SSO enforcement if available.

[plans] Plan tiers
Starter includes up to 5 seats, 10,000 API calls per month and community support. Pro includes unlimited seats at a per-seat price, 250,000 API calls per month, SSO, audit logs and email support with a one-business-day response target. Enterprise adds a custom API quota, dedicated support with a four-hour response target, data residency options and a signed DPA. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated; downgrades apply at the next renewal.

Question: What is the response time for a severity-1 incident on the Enterprise plan?
